description: This file defines the BuzzService class within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to manage permissions related to Buzz posts and comments, including access controls and interaction with DAOs (Data Access Objects).

classes.name: BuzzService
classes.description: Provides permission management and data access functions for Buzz posts and comments in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getBuzzDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of BuzzDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of BuzzLikeDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: canUpdateBuzzFeedPost
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to update a Buzz feed post owned by the specified employee number.

methods.name: canDeleteBuzzFeedPost
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to delete a Buzz feed post owned by the specified employee number.

methods.name: canUpdateBuzzComment
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to update a Buzz comment owned by the specified employee number.

methods.name: canDeleteBuzzComment
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to delete a Buzz comment owned by the specified employee number.
